This tutorial showcases how to do high quality screen recordings with OBS using the best encoder Nvidia and AMD settings. Unfortunately, not all low spec computers or laptop best recording settings can record with the best OBS settings because they don't have a dedicated graphics card or they're without a powerful CPU (processor). This method works on Windows and OBS settings for streaming and recording in high quality with low file size.
